scope: Transient bounded validation presentation/qualification, not persisted source bounds, general renderer adoption or a performance guarantee

implementationProof.normative: The mathematical projection/kernel/coverage/composition, device/view scope, numeric error limits and probes are normative. Owned full-source CPU evaluation and a conservative current-view error certificate remain mandatory.
implementationProof.baseline: Direct-conic attributes/evaluation and etaQ below form one executable sufficient proof path, not a requirement to keep an inefficient arithmetic representation forever.
implementationProof.equivalentImplementation: A mathematically equivalent evaluation such as a covariance factor/whitener is ordinary implementation only when a conservative bound is independently derived for its actual uploaded values and shader arithmetic, satisfies these same per-view limits and probes, and passes independent review before activation. Do not merely reuse the direct-conic formula for different parameters or change source/presentation policy. No renewed PO decision is required for such an in-contract numerical improvement.

coordinates.cssViewport: finite width/height32..4096; DPR1..2; renderScale1; drawing width/height round(cssExtent*DPR), positive and<=8192
coordinates.sample: full drawing-buffer pixel centre(x+0.5,y+0.5), top-left origin; tiled probe must restore the full-buffer origin

projection.mean: CPU binary64 complete source-to-camera transform, never GPU mean-only transform or packed coordinates
projection.orthographic: centre follows the admitted ProjectCamera extents; J=[[cssWidth/(right-left),0,0],[0,-cssHeight/(top-bottom),0]]
projection.covarianceCss: J*SigmaCamera*transpose(J)+0.3*I;0.3 is fixed CSS-pixel-squared reconstruction variance; no FOV/J clamp, opacity-energy compensation or source covariance rewrite
projection.clip: centre depth -z must lie in the closed admitted near/far interval; outside centres produce no fragment. Camera-at-mean produces no fragment. Invalid/uncertain finite projection fails local GS capability, not source validation. Do not guess a near-plane intersection surface.

ownedUpload.inputs: CPU evaluates full source SH/IEC color, alpha, projected centre/covariance and depth for the current source/frame/view; upload owned screen attributes only
ownedUpload.round: qf(v)=Float32(v), with abs(qf(v))<2^-40 canonicalized to0 in transient buffers only; never alter source data
ownedUpload.attributes: Baseline: centrePx, inverse covariancePx symmetric entries, unassociated linear RGB, alpha and centre depth; actual rounded values are the capability predicate's inputs. Equivalent certified parameters follow implementationProof.
ownedUpload.identity: one current source/frame/view generation; stale completion or a changed view invalidates draw/pick preparation

fragment.quadratic: Mathematical Q=d^T*inverse(covariancePx)*d. Baseline GPU evaluates max(0,A00*dx*dx+2*A01*dx*dy+A11*dy*dy),d=full-buffer sample-uploaded centre; all highp; discard Q>8. Equivalent certified evaluation follows implementationProof.
fragment.falloff: a32*lookupExpMinusHalf(Q); no0.99 cap, no per-source color transfer after CPU evaluation, no opacity compensation
fragment.output: premultiplied linear RGB*alpha and alpha; GS centre depth is constant across its footprint
fragment.quad: conservative axis-aligned ellipse rectangle plus one physical pixel padding, clipped to viewport; no clipping of an admitted fragment by a tight quad

falloffLookup.samples: qf(exp(-4*k/4096)), k=0..4096; deterministic CPU-owned values, checked against the analytic oracle
falloffLookup.texture: R32F256x17, nearest/no mipmaps; index k maps to(k mod256,floor(k/256)); unused texels are0
falloffLookup.evaluation: k=min(4095,floor(512*clamp(Q,0,8)));t=512*Q-k; two texelFetch reads and explicit highp linear interpolation; no float-linear capability assumption

capability.device: WebGL2 highp precision>=23 and exponent range>=127; actual R32F fetch, linear RGBA16F render/blend and final IEC output probes pass; no GL/shader/readback/context error. Missing capability leaves Mesh/Point on their existing path and GS Unsupported.
capability.perVisiblePrimitive: For each nonempty source splat whose conservative quad intersects the viewport, all source/current-view/rounded values must be finite; reference and uploaded covariance inverse must be SPD; nonzero uploaded conic entries lie in[2^-40,2^20] by absolute value; uploaded centre and max sample offsets D0,D1 have magnitude<=8192. Any failure makes that GS visual unavailable, never silently drops one in-view splat.
capability.colorCheck: CPU canonical linear RGB and alpha versus uploaded qf values differ by<=2^-20 per channel; source a<1/510 is skipped before rounding
capability.etaQ: u=2^-23,gamma32=32*u/(1-32*u),delta=qf(centrePx)-centrePx; Di=max abs(sample_i-qf(centrePx)_i) on the padded quad intersected with viewport; B=abs(A00-C00)*D0^2+2*abs(A01-C01)*D0*D1+abs(A11-C11)*D1^2+2*(abs((C*delta)0)*D0+abs((C*delta)1)*D1)+abs(transpose(delta)*C*delta); S=abs(A00)*D0^2+2*abs(A01)*D0*D1+abs(A11)*D1^2; etaQ=B+gamma32*(S+1); require etaQ<=2^-12. The unit term covers subnormal/flush error under the explicit bounded operands; overflow is refused.
capability.outcome: This exact current-view predicate must pass before publishing its GS display receipt. Failure is local Unsupported with a useful view/scale diagnostic; it is not an input rewrite, source rejection, silently omitted primitive, new saved setting or successful renderer claim. Re-evaluate on source/frame/camera/viewport/DPR change.

composition.target: linear RGBA16F with functional render/blend verification; no tone mapping, exposure1; final IEC linear-to-sRGB conversion exactly once
composition.opaqueFirst: existing opaque/binary Mesh and opaque Point color/depth pass; preserve their source/display/pick rules
composition.gs: depthTest against opaque fragment-depth buffer using strict Less; GS uses constant centre depth, depthWrite false; premultiplied source-over with ONE,ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA; far-to-near by camera mean depth across admitted GS assets
composition.equalDepth: ascending stable tuple(source Blob SHA256 as lowercase hex, original source ordinal as integer, complete source-to-project4x4 numerical matrix as16column-major entries compared numerically/lexicographically with negative zero normalized); identical tuple/render values commute; no random renderer IDs or draw/LOD indices
composition.overlapPicking: GS target uses its explicit proxy exception. Direct Mesh/Point hits require no admitted GS contribution at their canonical hit sample in the same frame. Point-radius fallback applies the identical GS query to each actual covered visibility-proof sample used by01a, requiring at least one Point-covered sample with no GS contribution after opaque depth; neither click-only nor centre-only checks prove that. Preserve01a's no-Mesh-fragment and ranked-ambiguity rules. Unknown proof refuses placement and offers existing model isolation. No direct-splat ID/depth/position is returned.

qualification.covariance: compare 2D buffer covariance before rasterization, same max-entry formula as capability; source 3D covariance has its separate1e-12 oracle
qualification.measurement: read linear premultiplied RGBA before final IEC output; decode half values when that is the actual read format. Source RGB comparison is unassociated CPU/GPU attribute color, never divided by near-zero alpha. Boundary guards are derived from the analytic contours and the0.25CSS bound, not arbitrary ignored pixels. Fixed-probe composite tolerance is not a universal all-scene image guarantee.

rotatedAnisotropic.xReflection: Apply complete source-to-project x reflection: screen off-diagonal covariance and conic signs reverse, and the two sample Q/alpha results swap.

fullShColorUpload.camera: same perspective settings, position[-1.3363062095621219,-2.6726124191242437,-4.008918628686366], target origin, up[0,1,0], DPR1, centre pixel[16,16]

probeProtocol.equalDepthOrder: at common centre depth5, green stable source key00...00 draws before red keyff...ff, source ordinal0 and identity transform; expect the same[0.5,0.25,0.25,1] result
clipCases: centre beyond near/far produces no fragment
invalid or uncertain depth/projection is Unsupported, not guessed

capabilityCases.name: ordinary centred ortho primitive at DPR1 and2
same view with unavailable half-float blend or failed probe
capabilityCases.expect: GS Unsupported; existing Mesh/Point path retained

capabilityCases.name: non-SPD uploaded conic, nonfinite projection, stale view generation
